race.title: All Weather Championship Is Back Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
race.verdict: BOOK OF LIFE is much more reliable than most at this level and if they go hard, these could be the ideal circumstances for him to end a losing run having looked unlucky a few times lately. Wrist Art often goes well in this type of event and King David is very well treated now so needs respecting. BOOK OF LIFE WRIST ART (IRE) KING DAVID (IRE)
